today_summary: GCM26 marked $3,566.3 on the 26 Nov scrape — independently parity-verified at $3,562 — with ATM IV 29.53% putting the 1σ daily move at $66 (1.86%). That envelope, $3,500–$3,633, is bracketed almost exactly by the two dominant OI walls: the $3,500 put wall (6,488 contracts) and the $3,600 call wall (3,725). Max pain sits far above at $4,450, +$884 (+24.8%) from spot — a legacy-call artifact rather than a live magnet, with P/C OI 0.56 and 98,445 call contracts stacked above spot. Net GEX across the ±$200 band is -113.9, so dealers are short gamma into both edges of that range.
five_day_thesis: The honest headline this week is a data break, not a repositioning: Barchart's feed changed between 24 and 26 Nov — total call OI collapsed 317,729 → 99,858, the strike band narrowed $1,350–$10,000 → $2,000–$9,100, DTE resolved from null to 62, and 390 placeholder rows (call_last pinned at $0.1) vanished. The pre-26 Nov snapshots were a stale aggregate — $5,500 call OI sat frozen at exactly 16,556 contracts for four consecutive sessions — so the apparent deltas of max pain -$950 and call wall $5,500 → $5,000 are artifacts of the feed change and should not be traded. What remains comparable is price and vol: spot has bled -$175.5 (-4.7%) from $3,741.8 on 19 Nov along a lower-high sequence ($3,741.8 → $3,685.4 → $3,651.4 → $3,566.3), while the 23 Nov low of $3,515.5 has not been retested. ATM IV carries the real regime signal — it spiked 24.49% → 38.0% into the 23 Nov flush, then bled back to 29.53%, still +3.87pp above the 19 Nov base of 25.66%. No 25 Nov snapshot exists because that scraper run failed, so this is a four-session comparison.
what_changed: Barchart feed structure changed between 24 and 26 Nov — call OI 317,729 → 99,858, DTE null → 62, 390 placeholder rows gone; every OI-derived 5-day delta is discontinuous.
Spot has shed $175.5 (-4.7%) since 19 Nov on a lower-high sequence, with the 23 Nov low of $3,515.5 still unbroken.
ATM IV compressed 7.23pp off the 36.76% peak of 24 Nov to 29.53%, but holds 3.87pp above the 19 Nov base of 25.66%.
Put concentration at $3,500 now carries 6,488 contracts — 28% of all 22,950 put OI below spot sitting at one strike.
Gamma flip is absent above spot: cumulative net GEX stays negative across the entire $2,500–$9,100 band, leaving no stabilizing shelf to rotate into.
Flow barbelled away from the money — 3,573 puts traded at $3,000–$3,450 against 3,698 calls at $4,100–$4,450, with almost nothing transacting near spot.
prediction: Base case is a contained $3,500–$3,633 range while the 1σ envelope and the two OI walls agree; the $3,600 call wall (3,725 OI) $34 overhead, reinforced by a local positive-GEX pocket (+19.3), is the natural pin and the first level bulls must clear. A sustained break below $3,500 is the invalidation — net GEX there is -67.3 with put gamma at -72.2, the steepest short-gamma pocket in the chain, and support below thins fast to 1,517 contracts at $3,450 then a gap to 1,742 at $3,100. Above $3,600 the path opens toward $3,900 (3,905 call OI), but nothing in current positioning argues for a drift toward max pain $4,450.
